Job Title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI / GenAI / AWS)

Experience: 5-8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer with 5-8 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Agentic AI systems, autonomous AI workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and Generative AI technologies. The candidate should also possess hands-on experience with LLM frameworks, Python development, and AWS cloud services to build scalable, production-grade AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions leveraging autonomous agents and multi-agent architectures.
Build intelligent AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI frameworks.
Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, memory management, tool usage, and workflow orchestration.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and external tools.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize LLM performance for business-specific use cases.
Develop scalable backend services using Python and cloud-native AWS services.
Collaborate with data scientists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Implement monitoring, observability, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
Stay updated with emerging advancements in Agentic AI, LLMs, and AI infrastructure technologies.

Required Technical Skills

Secondary Skills: GenAI & LLM Frameworks




Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related discipline.
5-8 years of software engineering experience with strong AI/ML exposure.
Minimum 2+ years working on Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and distributed systems.
Experience delivering AI applications from Proof of Concept (POC) to Production.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.Role & responsibilities
